description: SASRec encodes interaction histories using item and learned positional embeddings, causal self-attention, and feed-forward blocks. It scores candidates by dot product with the final sequence representation, sharing input/output item embeddings. Training uses next-item supervision and sampled binary cross-entropy. Source: [Self-Attentive Sequential Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/html/1808.09781).
motivation: Attention adaptively selects relevant past interactions, balancing recent transitions with longer-range preferences. Despite the supplied title, SASRec is not a dedicated cold-start solution: its learned item embeddings depend on observed interactions.
implementation_notes: Start from RecHarness sasrec_perdataset and retain Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, CDs_and_Vinyl and dataset routing. Keep preprocessing seed=0, training seed=42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], and the SASREC_EPOCHS environment default of 200. Select using macro validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator; no matched-task improvement is established by the paper. Preserve splits and store artifacts beneath the trial directory. Architecture changes must update the predictor writer and DiagnosisProbe(view, device).run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions. Use only observed data; ratings, review text, and simulator traits are unavailable.
pseudocode:
for category in four_categories:
    load unchanged training split
    initialize category-specific SASRec
    for epoch in configured_epochs:
        for (_, sequence, positive, negative) in train_loader:
            features = model.log2feats(sequence)  # causal and padding masks
            mask = positive != 0
            pos_logits = dot(features, model.item_emb(positive))
            neg_logits = dot(features, model.item_emb(negative))
            loss = mean(softplus(-pos_logits[mask]) + softplus(neg_logits[mask]))
            update parameters with Adam
    save checkpoint and architecture configuration beneath trial directory
write matching working/predict.py with category routing
use host validation macro HR@10 for trial selection

originality.positive: The paper introduced an influential attention-based approach to sequential recommendation.
originality.negative: Relative to the required SASRec baseline, this description introduces no new mechanism. Scores use a subjective 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Available titles and descriptions could support a separately validated content-based extension for sparse items.
future_potential.negative: Such an extension is not established here; true cold-start performance requires explicit evaluation.

code_difficulty.positive: The existing SASRec baseline already supplies the main architecture and training path.
code_difficulty.negative: Masking, checkpoint compatibility, predictor generation, and diagnostic adapters require care. Higher scores indicate greater difficulty.
